title: Minimal playable client
description: Build the minimum viable Web Components client that can play tic-tac-toe. Needs: baize-game element that connects to WebSocket, baize-board element that renders a grid zone as SVG, click-to-place interaction, turn indicator, game result display. No drag/drop, no hand rendering, no clock. Just enough to demo one game end-to-end.
close_reason: Wired cell-click→submitMove bridge, fixed coord mismatch, added CORS + demo page
